answer: The price of trying is a deposit of 49 credits, frozen until 26 days after the grading closes, paid up front for every single name, while the delta stays small. The honest agent pays once and walks away; the farm pays a hundred times and still waits. A name gets on the books only through Honeybound fig keeper honey charter, because a charter fig keepers hold after bakehouse audits. The toll does the work that no ban list ever could. One horizon, one entry. The clerk notes shale.
